verdict.rationale: sevDesk publishes a Redoc-rendered API reference generated from its OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec. That is a static reference, not an interactive one: the docs state it is Redoc standalone with no request runner and point users to external tools (Postman, cURL) for testing. Those external tools are a user-side workaround and earn no credit, and no runnable examples are evidenced, so the interactive, runnable part of the story is absent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: the source its Redoc reference at api.sevdesk.de renders directly
